# TheAmericanDeal.org: The National Sovereignty and Resilience Act (NSRA)

> The NSRA is a citizen-drafted federal DISCUSSION DRAFT. It has NOT been introduced in, considered by, or passed by either chamber of Congress. It is a 37-title, 233-section bill on household costs: zero-premium baseline health coverage, G7-median drug pricing, a $35 insulin cap, a 50-home-per-metro institutional homebuyer cap, zero-interest federal student loans, and a full congressional stock trading ban. It is open to adoption by any sponsor. Fiscal figures are internal models on the CBO February 2026 baseline, not official CBO/JCT scores. Drafted by Santonio D. Sanders. Not affiliated with any party, PAC, or elected official.
